steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for subjunctive mood and complex structures. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons. | GCSE Spanish Exam Tips: The subjunctive is used after expressions of will, emotion, doubt and impersonal expressions. Form the present subjunctive by swapping the -ar/-er/-ir endings. Common triggers: quiero que, es necesario que, dudo que, ojalá. Higher marks require accurate subjunctive use.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about subjunctive mood and complex structures. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on subjunctive mood and complex structures. | Translate into Spanish: "I think subjunctive mood and complex structures is important because..."
